name: EEI Manufacturing Services
old_description: For the latest news, capabilities and solutions, visit Impact
about:
EEI Manufacturing Services, now operating as Impact ES–Clearwater, is based in Clearwater, Florida. The business traces its roots to the Pacific Northwest through its parent company, Impact Electronic Solutions, which is headquartered in Lake Oswego, Oregon. EEI brought over 25 years of leadership in advanced PCB assembly technology before the subsidiary brands were unified under the Impact Electronic Solutions name in a recent reorganization. The transition was described as a visual and organizational change only, with all service levels, contacts, and operations remaining consistent.

Impact ES–Clearwater provides full-service electronics design and manufacturing, centered on advanced PCB assembly. Its capabilities span value-added engineering services, prototype and full-turnkey production, troubleshooting, and bottom-up design. The company operates as part of a multisite network of full-service design and manufacturing facilities that also includes locations in Cranston, Rhode Island; Grants Pass, Oregon; Vancouver, Washington; and Ventura, California.

The facility serves aerospace, defense, homeland security, military and defense, space, autonomous and robotics, commercial and industrial, and medical and life sciences sectors. Customers include industry leaders in these fields who require robust turnkey solutions and advanced manufacturing to meet demands for agility and quality, including alignment with the Defense Department's Better Buying Power affordability initiative.

The company states its vision is to be the most and agile supplier of advanced, cost-effective electronics manufacturing for customers supporting national defense and security. It emphasizes being an extension of the customer's organization, with a focus on service, quality, and innovation as the reasons customers return.

name: EIC Semiconductor Inc
old_description: EIC, a leading designer and manufacturer of circuit protection devices, has expanded its range of transient voltage suppressors
about:
EIC Semiconductor Inc is headquartered in Irwindale, California. The company operates as a manufacturer of discrete semiconductor devices.

EIC provides end-to-end manufacturing with a dedicated wafer fabrication facility and assembly plant, allowing control over quality and supply. The company produces a broad portfolio of discrete semiconductors, including Zener diodes, switching diodes, rectifier diodes, transient voltage suppressors (TVS), thyristors, and small-signal transistors. Its catalog encompasses over 15,000 part numbers across more than 50 package types. TVS devices range from 150 W to 50,000 W, while silicon rectifier diodes offer avalanche voltages up to 2,500 V and reverse voltages up to 3,000 V, with AEC-Q101 qualification. High-voltage ultra-fast recovery rectifiers are available with reverse voltages from 7,500 V to 12,000 V.

The company serves automotive electronics, automotive rectifier diodes, aviation, medical, power supply, industrial electronics, and consumer electronics markets.

EIC emphasizes its integrated wafer fab and assembly operations as a means to ensure quality control and supply continuity, supported by what it describes as powerful research capabilities.

name: ELIS Manufacturing & Packaging Solutions
old_description: ELIS Manufacturing & Packaging Solutions specializes in tailored blending and end-to-end contract manufacturing for nutraceuticals and consumables.
about:
ELIS Manufacturing & Packaging Solutions operates from a single facility in Kaufman, Texas. The company began at a family kitchen table in Kaufman and has spent the last decade growing into a contract manufacturer whose clients’ products appear on shelves across the United States and internationally. It remains family-owned and founder-led, with Keith Vinson serving as owner and CEO; the name honors his grandfather, Ellis, whose work ethic the company says guides its operations.

ELIS provides turnkey contract manufacturing and packaging for nutraceuticals and consumables. Its services span product development, ingredient sourcing, blending, encapsulation, flavoring and formulating, filling (bottles, pouches, sachets, stick packs), printing (roll stock, pouch, screen printing on bottles), kitting, fulfillment, warehousing and shipping. The facility handles powders, liquids, creams, gels, tablets and capsules, and the company notes it applies the same quality standards to runs as small as 2,000 units and as large as 200,000 units.

The company serves brands in the nutraceutical, beauty and cosmetics, food and beverage, pet food and sports nutrition categories. Its customers include brands such as TryCinny.com, STROKESGAINED, Freedom Tea Co, Glucose SOS and Nutra Coast, whose products are stocked by major retailers nationwide.

ELIS was created after its founders experienced unreliable co-packers while launching their own product line. They built the company to offer a design-to-delivery partner under one roof, with a dedicated project manager who knows each product’s timeline and launch window, and a team that treats every client’s product as its own.

name: ELITE MEDICAL SUPPLIES
old_description: At Elite Medical Supplies, We Strive To Provide: Great Product Selection, Friendly Customer Service, Fast Delivery & Everyday Low Prices.
about:
Elite Medical Supplies, LLC operates from Laramie, Wyoming, with a second location in Casper. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm distributes a broad range of medical, industrial, and scientific supplies. Its product catalog includes mobility aids such as walkers, rollators, canes, and crutches; bath aids including commodes, shower chairs, and grab bars; bedroom equipment like home hospital beds and pressure mattresses; incontinence products; catheter supplies; and wound care items. The company also offers rental and bulk purchase options for facilities and individuals.

Elite Medical Supplies serves healthcare providers, industrial clients, and scientific institutions. It bills Medicare, Medicaid, and Blue Cross Blue Shield directly, and works with other insurance carriers. Customers include patients seeking home care equipment, hospitals, and long-term care facilities. The company maintains showrooms in both Laramie and Casper for in-person product selection.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, stating it offers top-quality products at lower prices than other suppliers. It highlights reliable customer service, noting that its team works in the healthcare industry and advocates for customers when adjusting its product catalog. Fast delivery and everyday low prices are cited as core commitments.

about:
EMSI – Electrostim Medical Services, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. The business was founded in 1995 by Mario Garcia, Jr., who serves as chairman and founder. Garcia, a Tampa native, established the company as a start-up and has since grown it into a national operation.

The company specializes in home electrical stimulation devices, bracing, and accessories for pain management and physical rehabilitation. EMSI reports serving over 70,000 patients and employs approximately 400 people across its operations. Its services include billing, patient support, customer service, Medicare processing, and accounts receivable management.

EMSI’s primary customers are patients seeking home-based electrotherapy and bracing solutions, as well as healthcare providers in pain management and physical rehabilitation. The company works with Medicare and other payers, and its Total Medical Resources division supplies medical products, supplies, and services to clients nationally.

EMSI emphasizes its accreditations as differentiators: it is Joint Commission accredited, a member of ADMEA, recognized by Cigna Healthy Workforce, and its devices are FDA approved. The founder’s original aim was to build a national medical device company focused on efficient, professional service that increases client profitability.

name: EPTAM Precision | Plastics
old_description: From design-for-manufacturing through scalable production – every discipline aligned, every time.
about:
EPTAM Precision operates from Northfield, New Hampshire, under the leadership of President and Chief Financial Officer Graham Schillmoller. The company provides advanced precision manufacturing solutions for high-technology sectors.

The company specializes in polymer machining, precision metal component machining and micro-machining, laser cutting and welding, plastic injection molding, liquid silicone rubber molding, and additive manufacturing. It runs a dedicated medical manufacturing center equipped with dry-machining technology and ISO Class 7 and 8 cleanrooms, and offers value-added services including design-for-manufacturing, process validation, cleanroom molding, and technical program management. Rapid prototyping is handled through its READI development facilities, which are reserved for fast-turn work separate from production.

EPTAM serves the medical device industry across specialties such as cardiology, orthopedics, neurology, diagnostics, robotics, and minimally invasive surgery, as well as the space, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor sectors. Its customer base includes OEMs developing implants, surgical instruments, catheters, wearables, and diagnostic equipment.

It emphasizes a “rhythm” of alignment across design-for-manufacturing, production, and quality assurance from the first conversation through validated scale, supported by an electronic quality management system with full traceability and a phase-gate new product introduction process.

EQUITAS Life Sciences, LLC is based in Essex Junction, Vermont, with an office in Essex. The company was founded on the core values of humility, integrity, and quality, which remain central to its culture. While the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the firm describes itself as a global life science information company built by a diverse team with decades of combined industry experience.

The company provides management consulting, e-healthcare solutions, and staff augmentation to the life sciences sector. Its consulting expertise spans global market access, pricing and reimbursement, launch strategy, commercial excellence, and creative services. EQUITAS differentiates itself by combining traditional management consulting with software development capabilities, using technology as an enabler to deliver tailored solutions. The team conducts global research through a worldwide expert network to inform clinical trial design, product launches, and acquisition targets.

EQUITAS serves pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic companies, as well as healthcare providers, payers, and patients. Its partners range from firms bringing novel therapeutics and devices to market to those seeking investment to support innovation. The company engages across the healthcare continuum to provide actionable insights for evolving business needs.

The firm's founding principle was to bring key healthcare decision-makers together for the single purpose of improving patient outcomes. It emphasizes collaboration, respect, empathy, responsiveness, and flexibility, aiming to become an extended member of its partners' teams through seamless communication and shared goals.

about:
ESI Electronic Products Corporation was founded in 1982 in Prospect, Connecticut. The company began as an OEM supplier of advanced displays, motor controls, applications, and software for fitness, rehabilitation, and medical equipment.

Today, ESI designs and manufactures touch-screen consoles, PWM motor controls and drives, and custom software for fitness and medical devices. The firm operates a vertically integrated facility in Prospect, Connecticut, where all products are built to IPC electronics industry standards and 100% tested. A global production footprint extends to Mexico and overseas, supporting contract manufacturing and custom product development from design through lifetime support.

ESI serves the fitness equipment, medical and rehabilitation, and industrial instrumentation markets. Its components are installed in equipment sold to homes, health clubs, rehabilitation clinics, and hospitals. Longstanding OEM customers include Nautilus Inc., Woodway, Landice, Biodex, Cybex, True Fitness, Schwinn, and StairMaster.

The company emphasizes quality and precision through ISO 9001:2015 certification and a commitment to eliminating design-transfer risks via its one-stop-shop model. Global sourcing capabilities reduce supply-chain disruption, while a 100% lifetime product support program backs every unit shipped.

name: ESL Power Systems, Inc.
old_description: UL508A-listed custom control panels for industrial/power/utility applications
about:
ESL Power Systems, Inc. operates from Corona, California, where it was founded in the early 1990s. The company is 100% employee-owned, a structure that aligns its workforce directly with customer outcomes. From its inception, ESL focused on custom-engineered electrical equipment for demanding power applications.

The company designs and manufactures a range of electrical power distribution and control products. Its core offering is UL508A-listed custom control panels built to customer specifications. Additional product lines include safety-interlocked reefer outlets for intermodal use, ship-to-shore power distribution for military and commercial ports, emergency generator hook-up equipment with cam-style connectors, and the ShowSwitch™ company switch for entertainment venues. ESL also produces the eTRUconnect™ system for electric transport refrigeration units, eRTG fused disconnect cabinets for rubber-tire gantries, shipyard power equipment, wayside power for passenger rail, and industrial portable power units.

ESL serves industries that require reliable, safe power connections in harsh or regulated environments. Customers include intermodal and refrigerated cargo operators, military and commercial shipyards, entertainment venues, rail operators needing temporary wayside power, and industrial facilities requiring portable or emergency power solutions. The company's UL508A panel shop supports custom control panel needs across these sectors.

Employee ownership drives ESL's stated differentiation: the company emphasizes a culture of ownership, teamwork, adaptability, continuous improvement, and excellence in customer experience. It positions itself as a collaborative engineering partner that tailors solutions to each project, aiming to keep businesses operational while reducing environmental impact.

name: ETEMCO
old_description: Since 1952, we’ve delivered superior-quality PCB solutions for complex, custom applications.
about:
ETEMCO was established in 1952 in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, by four entrepreneurs who set out to design and manufacture test equipment for the RCA picture tube factory. The business expanded from that initial contract into a full-service electronic and electromechanical manufacturing company, and it has remained in Lancaster for over seven decades.

The company provides printed circuit board assembly services from prototype through production, specializing in high-mix, low-to-medium volume runs typically ranging from fewer than 100 units to 25,000 units depending on complexity. Its capabilities include surface-mount technology (SMT) with high-speed pick-and-place equipment, through-hole assembly, selective soldering, automated optical inspection (2D and 3D AOI), conformal coating and RTV dispensing via a PVA Delta 8 four-axis system, and PDR infrared rework for non-contact component repair. The firm emphasizes a seamless prototype-to-production transition and invests heavily in advanced equipment to maintain quality.

ETEMCO serves customers in medical and healthcare (diagnostic imaging, implantable devices), telecommunications and networking (network infrastructure, wireless communication), industrial automation and controls, military and law enforcement, transportation and mobility (automotive, aerospace, maritime), and security and access control (motion sensors, security sensors, linear drives). The company also supports broadcast equipment and asset tracking applications.

Founded on a mission of innovation and precision, ETEMCO differentiates itself through a quality-driven culture, on-time delivery focus, and responsive communication. The company states that quality drives its entire operation, from skilled production teams and precise component placement to stringent quality control, and it prioritizes efficiency without sacrificing quality to meet tight deadlines.
